resources.string: Ad choices

BharatX can show ads from Appnext on this VPN screen. Appnext processes your IP address, device and app identifiers, installed-app information, advertising ID when available, and ad interactions to select, deliver and measure ads. Location may also be processed if Android permissions allow it. BharatX does not provide your browsing history, website addresses, VPN packets or DNS requests to this integration. Tap Allow ads to enable the SDK. You can change this choice here later. Declining keeps Free VPN available; rewarded Premium access needs an ad or an active subscription.
